title: Italy University Admission and Regional Scholarship Overview + Live Q&A
description: Italian university admission and regional scholarships are two different processes. Learn how to plan both timelines, prepare financial documents, and avoid region-specific mistakes.
mentorHeading: Learn from someone who has already done it.
mentorBio: Hi, I’m Aasheer Ishaque Taswar, a Mechanical Engineer currently pursuing an MSc in Engineering and Management at Politecnico di Torino.

I am an EDISU Scholarship recipient for my master’s degree and a Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship recipient for my bachelor’s degree. Having successfully navigated two major scholarship journeys, I understand what it takes to build a strong profile, make smart application decisions, and stand out in a competitive process.

For the past five years, I have mentored students from across the world on university selection, scholarship applications, study-abroad planning, and career development. More than 100 students I have guided are now studying abroad.

My mentoring style is practical, honest, and results-focused. I do not believe in generic advice. I help students understand their strengths, improve their strategy, avoid common mistakes, and approach the application process with confidence.

Alongside study-abroad guidance, I can also support students interested in mechanical engineering, automotive and industrial careers, project management, lean manufacturing, and combining technical expertise with business and leadership skills.
If you are looking for clear guidance, real scholarship insights, and a mentor who will challenge you to think bigger and plan better, I am here to help.
